CROSS-APP CONTRACT: SEALED APP FILE MANIFEST AS DMG SIDECAR (v2)
================================================================
Date: 2026-11-07
Branch: fix/sealed-manifest-20261107
Base: 91c069b
Contract State: PROPOSED v2 - GATEWAY AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE 2026-11-07.
  Gateway awaits the exact v2 fixture hash before coding. No product code
  until that ACK. No new wire field, route or status is invented here.

1. PROBLEM (proven on 0.6.224)
-------------------------------
Manifest generation before outer deep codesign leaves stale native digests
and omits CodeResources; regenerating after the seal mutates sealed resources
and fails `codesign --verify --deep --strict`. The closure cannot live inside
the signed bundle.

2. SOLUTION
-----------
The manifest is a DMG SIDECAR, outside the sealed app:
  <dmg_mount_root>/Studio Hub.app/
  <dmg_mount_root>/file-manifest/{index.json, core.tsv.gz, runtime-*.tsv.gz}
No file-manifest/ inside Contents/Resources/. Sign first (final signed native
+ CodeResources closure), then scan and write the sidecar; no app mutation
after seal. Codesign qualification is PENDING packaging-worker proof; nothing
here claims codesign passed from fake fixture bytes. Producer staging path is
the packaging worker's choice.

3. SCHEMA (UNCHANGED WIRE)
--------------------------
"studiohub.file-manifest.v1"; index fields and group TSV line format exactly
as in the fixture. files_sha256 = SHA256 of sorted "name\0group_sha\n" lines.

4. CONSUMER LOOKUP
------------------
Priority 1: <root>/file-manifest/ (sealed releases).
Priority 2: <root>/Studio Hub.app/Contents/Resources/file-manifest/ (legacy).
Priority 3: neither -> RELEASE_NO_MANIFEST.
A present-but-malformed/corrupt preferred sidecar REFUSES; it never falls
back to a valid legacy copy (AC6).

5. BASELINE IDENTITY & DELTA ELIGIBILITY (agreed in principle 2026-11-07)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Identity source: strict actual running version from GET /api/version.
A held/target future release.version NEVER qualifies a running baseline.
Threshold: first shipped fixed release = 0.6.225 (PROPOSED; freezes at
release). Build proof is recorded; there is no runtime exact-build allowlist.
  - running 0.6.224 or older -> full (existing whole-DMG path)
  - unknown / malformed / ambiguous / prerelease identity -> full fail-closed
  - known RELEASED fixed-or-later baseline + existing delta capability dict
    -> delta eligible. Hub emits that existing capability ONLY after
    validating and rescanning installed bytes.
AppUpdateKey_untrusted is a publisher-key trust gate, NOT baseline
evaluation; key/hash/signature guards are unchanged.

6. ACCEPTANCE CASES (fixture metadata; DATA ONLY - actual Gateway tests PENDING)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AC1 running 224 + actual delta dict {schema,manifest,artifact} -> full, no
    delta upload; held 0.6.225 must not mask running 224.
AC2 unknown/malformed/ambiguous identity -> full fail-closed.
AC3 prerelease identity (even >= threshold) -> full fail-closed.
AC4 known released fixed-or-later + validated existing capability -> delta eligible.
AC5 valid preferred sidecar wins over valid legacy.
AC6 corrupt preferred sidecar REFUSES even when valid legacy exists.
AC7 corrupt native or CodeResources rejects BEFORE push (actual hash compare).
AC8 corrupted group rejects (index commits to group digest).
AC9 legacy accepted only with valid byte closure; no exclusions.
Reader observations on fixture 8ccf880...: sidecar-only RELEASE_NO_MANIFEST
(stock Gateway has no sidecar reader yet); legacy accepted; corrupt native
accepted (KNOWN BUG - reader does not verify app bytes); corrupt group
RELEASE_MANIFEST_INVALID. Stale-224 disk-vs-manifest mismatches are retained
as unit data; the earlier fictional wire probe is replaced by the actual
authenticated 0.6.224/d5632c6 capture shape.

7. AFFECTED FILES (post-ACK implementation; none changed by this fixture)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hub: packaging/stage_voice.py, packaging/make_dmg.py,
components/hub/backend/file_manifest.py, release_delta.py, standalone.py.
Gateway: gateway/release_publisher.py load_manifest sidecar priority.
Installed new-release sidecar consumer persistence/rescan followthrough:
EXPLICIT OPEN - no field decision invented.

No product code modified; waiting for Gateway ACK on the exact v2 hash.
